tools.name: search_registry_items
tools.description: Search Frontic UI items by name and description. An empty query lists all; `tier` narrows to ui, sections, templates, lib or composables. Read one with get_item_docs; get_item_examples gives its examples alone.

tools.name: get_item_docs
tools.description: Return the docs of Frontic UI items: install command, examples, how the parts nest, every part's props, events and slots, what else the item exports, styling, source, and the API of the items its example uses.

tools.name: get_item_examples
tools.description: Return a Frontic UI item's examples as source, the main one first. Pass `example`, a slug such as `sale` for `price.sale.example.vue`, for one alone; `main` is the main example.

tools.name: get_add_command
tools.description: Return the CLI command that adds Frontic UI items to a project.
